entries.zh: 串连成串；把物件依次排成一行
entries.en: to string together; to arrange in a row or series
entries.notes: H「粿」与 M uē、R cò 音形皆不合，L 末「ca.」疑为缩写残迹，仅依 L「retahila（成串、成行）」定。

entries.zh: 堆叠、摞起；把东西一层层叠放（引申为整理、陈设）
entries.en: to stack up, to pile one thing on another; to arrange, set in order
quiet, still; to quiet, to hush
entries.notes: H 首字作「遏」而标[疑]，M/R 皆作 an-，当为「安」，故按「安靜」释；L 义迂曲。

entries.en: to put down, to suppress, to check by force
entries.notes: H「遏殺」非成词，M 末音 chā 与 R 末音 fā 不合，音义两歧。

entries.zh: 结彩；张挂彩绸装饰牌楼、戏台
entries.en: to hang up festoons, to decorate (an arch, a stage) with coloured silk

entries.zh: 结彩亭；扎彩的亭子（节庆、迎神用）
entries.en: a festooned pavilion decorated for festivals and processions

entries.zh: 排整齐；把人与物排列得整齐有序
entries.en: to arrange in order, to line up neatly

entries.zh: 祭文；为死者撰写、宣读的祭奠文辞
entries.en: a funeral address, an elegy for the dead

entries.zh: 祝文；记述死者行谊、于葬祭时焚化的告祭文
entries.en: a funeral prayer or address recounting the deceased's deeds, to be burned
entries.notes: L「y dalam lequemar」当作「y darla a quemar」（付火焚化），据此定。

entries.zh: 整理衣裳；把衣服收束穿戴齐整
entries.en: to arrange one's clothes, to set one's dress in order
to be on good terms with them, to get along well
entries.notes: H 中字标[疑:省/首]，M cuā、R lcān 均难对应，唯「好」与 L「buenos」相合，义据 L 定。

entries.en: to compound medicines, to prepare drugs

entries.zh: 相处；与人打交道、料理交涉事务
entries.en: to deal with, to have dealings with; to settle a matter or transaction

entries.zh: 说合；居间调解、撮合双方
entries.en: to reconcile, to mediate between parties, to bring them to agreement
entries.notes: L「Secaucngan」为讹写难解，据 H「說合」定调解、撮合义。

entries.zh: 叠起；把一物摞在另一物之上
entries.en: to pile up, to stack one thing on top of another

entries.zh: 时文；应科举的八股文章，时下通行之文体
entries.en: contemporary-style prose; the examination essay (eight-legged essay)
